title: ESAT-6 as a named RD1 antigen
dek: EsxA/ESAT-6 on Wikipedia is the peptide IGRAs use and ESX-1 secretes. Secretion-system mechanics stay on tb-esx-secretion.
story: ESAT-6 (EsxA) on Wikipedia is a small secreted protein, partnered with CFP-10 (EsxB), encoded in RD1 and exported by ESX-1. BCG lost this locus — which is why IGRAs can ignore most BCG background.
The protein is also a virulence actor (membrane interaction stories). Simplfy's ESX secretion plate owns that mechanism. This card is the named antigen students see on IGRA package inserts.
Do not treat ESAT-6 serology folklore as a WRD. The licensed objects are IGRA/TBST and, separately, the secretion system in pathogenesis.
deep: CFP-10 is the heterodimer partner; many IGRAs use both peptides.
RD1 deletion is the BCG genetics plate.
Nontuberculous species that keep ESAT-6 homologs can theoretically trouble specificity — clinic IGRA plate territory.
Recombinant ESAT-6 in research vaccines is not this glossary's protocol.
